'''Pallos Thessius Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the first nephew of the Great Duke Organa and a loyal individual of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Pallos was very loyal to [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and held a grudge against [[House of Thul|House Thul]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Pallos met the new [[Havoc Squad]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Lieutenant]] who saved Castle Organa from an Imperial missile that was to be launched by [[Bex Kolos|Gearbox]]. He discovered that [[Markus Andarius Thul|Markus Thul]] had made a deal to provide information in exchange for his family's protection. Angry at Markus due to his attempted murder of Duke [[Charle Remmot Organa|Charle Organa]], Pallos did not accept this arrangement. He demanded to know what Havoc's mission was, but the CO refused to say, saying it was classified. Pallos felt insulted that an ally would not trust him.

After the Havoc CO rescued Markus' wife and daughter from House Thul and thwarted Gearbox, Pallos confronted them and Captain [[Balic Cormac]] again, concerned and disappointed that the Lieutenant had made a deal with Markus and that his prison cell had been turned into "a hotel for enemy nobles". He declared his intent to ensure that Markus would still pay for his assassination attempt; however, the Havoc CO informed him that Markus and his family would be released for his assistance in Havoc Squad's mission. Pallos complained to Havoc's superior officer, General ­[[Elin Garza]], who made the CO promise to avoid disaffecting an important ally again.
{{Endgame}}
